name: com.askshopi/shopi
title: Shopi
description: Sourced product verdicts and checked prices from Shopi. It never buys and takes no commission.

tools.name: get_verdict
tools.description: Shopi's verdict on a product, with the sources it was researched from. Give exactly one of: query (the product's name), gtin (a UPC/EAN barcode), or url (a Shopi product page link). Returns 'no sourced verdict' when Shopi has no verdict it can back with a source.

query.description: The product's name, e.g. 'Ankarsrum Original stand mixer'.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Prices Shopi has checked for a product at each store, each with the link it was read from and when. Use the product_id from get_verdict. Returns 'no checked price' when none is on record. Shopi takes no commission and runs no ads.

product.description: A Shopi product_id, as returned by get_verdict.

tools.name: check_owned
tools.description: Whether the signed-in shopper (or their household) already owns this product, with a count. Needs the shopper to connect Shopi. Use the product_id from get_verdict.

product.description: A Shopi product_id, as returned by get_verdict.

tools.name: get_desk
tools.description: What is waiting on the signed-in shopper's Shopi desk: recalls on things they own, standing requests and price watches, each with a title and a link. Needs the shopper to connect Shopi.

tools.name: add_request
tools.description: Leave a standing request on the signed-in shopper's Shopi desk: what they need and the most they'll spend. Shopi researches it and asks the shopper before anything is bought; it never buys or checks out by itself. Needs the shopper to connect Shopi with permission to add requests.

need.description: What they're shopping for, in their words, e.g. 'a quiet dishwasher'.

budget.description: The most they want to spend, in major units (800 = $800).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the budget; USD when omitted.

tools.name: add_watch
tools.description: Add a product to the signed-in shopper's Your Watches, so Shopi tells them when its price really drops. Use the product_id from get_verdict. It never buys anything. Needs the shopper to connect Shopi with permission to add watches.

product.description: A Shopi product_id, as returned by get_verdict.

target_price.description: The price the shopper hopes for, in major units. Recorded with the watch.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the target; USD when omitted.

tools.name: get_my_taste
tools.description: The signed-in shopper's stated shopping preferences on Shopi, in their own words, and their budget ceiling if they gave one. Use it to fit a recommendation to them. Needs the shopper to connect Shopi and allow "your stated preferences"; without that it returns how to allow it, and no data. It never returns their notes, searches or purchases.
